nav.label: Views
plant.label: Plant type
start.title: What are you designing?
start.intro: Choose a plant type. It sets the elements of the diagram and how plant drawings are read. You can change it at any time.
toolbar.label: Diagram tools
file.confirmNew: Start a new diagram? The current one is replaced; save it first if you need it.
file.invalid: This file is not a plantline diagram.
file.tooLarge: This file is too large to be a diagram.
file.notKept: This browser could not keep the diagram (its storage is full or blocked). Save it as a file.
overview.label: Overview: press to move the view there
shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
gesture.click: Click; Shift or Ctrl adds to the selection
gesture.area: Drag over the empty drawing: left to right selects what is inside, right to left what it touches
shortcut.nudge: Move by a grid step (five with Shift)
gesture.line: Drag from a connection point onto an element
gesture.pan: Space and drag, the middle button, or one finger
align.title: Align and space
connect.first: Choose the first element to connect.
connect.second: Now choose the element to connect it to. Press Escape to stop.
palette.title: Elements
palette.hint: Drag an element onto the diagram, or tap it to add it. On a touch screen, hold it a moment before dragging.
canvas.label: Single-line diagram
canvas.empty: Add elements from the list, then connect them.
inspector.title: Properties
link.hint: Drag a segment to move it, or an end segment to add a bend. Double-click a segment to remove it.
field.name: Name
field.label: Label
checks.title: Checks
layout.title: Plant layout from a drawing
layout.intro: Open an AutoCAD drawing (DWG or DXF) of the plant to see it on the map and count what it holds.
layout.private: Your drawing is read in this browser and never uploaded.
layout.largeConfirm: This drawing is large for this device ({{size}} MB): reading it can take several minutes and may close the page. Read it anyway?
layout.error.tooLarge: The drawing is larger than 100 MB.
layout.error.unsupported: Choose a DWG or DXF file.
layout.error.unreadable: This drawing could not be read.
layout.error.missing: The drawing reader could not be loaded. Check the connection and try again. If you run plantline yourself, build it with “pnpm cad”.
layout.truncated: The drawing is very large: only part of it is shown and counted.
layout.projInvalid: This coordinate system is not valid, or the drawing lies outside it.
layout.rulesHint: A block or layer whose name matches the pattern (a regular expression) is counted as that object.
error.title: Something went wrong.
error.body: Your diagram is kept in this browser. Reload the page, or download the diagram first.
